chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Isaak in Jakob samin amah thupha pia-in thuhilh a, “Nang in Kanaan numeite na ten’pih kei ding hi.
Ding in la, na nu’ pa Bethuel’ inn, Paddan-aram-ah pai in; tua lai munah na nu’ sanggampa Laban’ tanute khat na zi dingin la in.
Nang in mi honpi khat na suah theih nadingin Vanglian Pasian in nang thupha hong pia-in hong pungsakin, tampi hong phasak hen.
Pasian in Abraham’ tunga a piak, tawl khat sung na omna leitang na neih theih nadingin nang leh na suan-le-khakte' tungah amah in Abraham’ thupha hong pia ta hen!” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Isaak in Jakob sawlkhia hi; Jakob leh Esau’ nu Rebekah’ sanggampa, Aram mi Bethuel’ tapa Laban’ omna Paddan-aram-ah amah pai hi.
Isaak in Jakob thupha pia-in, zi la dingin Paddan-aram-ah sawl a, thupha a piak kawmin amah thuhilhin, “Kanaan numeite na ten’pih kei ding hi,” a cihna leh,
Jakob in a nu leh a pa’ thu mangin Paddan-aram-ah a paina thu tu-in Esau in thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kanaan numeite in a pa Isaak lungkimsak lo cih Esau in a theih ciangin,
Ishmael kiangah Esau pai-in, ama' zi neihsa banah, Nebaioth’ sanggamnu, Abraham’ tapa Isahmael’ tanu Mahalath zi-in la hi.
Jakob in Be-ersheba khua nusia-in, Haran lamah pai hi.
Amah mun khat tungin, ni tum khin ahih manin tua lai-ah tua zan giak hi. Tua mun-a suangte khat la-in, amah in lukhamin zang a, ihmu dingin tua munah lum suk hi.
Amah in mang man a, leitungah kahlei khat kiphutin, kahlei dawn in van ban hi; en in, Pasian’ vantungmite tua kahlei tungah kahto-in kumsuk uh hi.
En in, tua tung san-ah Topa ding a, “Keimah in na pa Abraham’ Pasian leh Isaak’ Pasian, Topa ka hi hi; nang leh na suan-le-khakte' tungah tu-a na lupna leitang kong pia ding hi;

na suan-le-khakte lei lak leivui bang ding a, nitumna lam leh nisuahna lam, leilu lam leh leitaw lamah na kizelthang ding uh hi; nang leh na suan-le-khakte thupha kong piak bangin leitung innkuan khempeuh in thupha a ngah nadingun hong ngen ding uh hi.

En in, keimah in nang tawh omin na paina peuhah kong kem ding a, hih leitangah nang kong paipih kik ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang' tunga kong gensa thute ka hih khit matengin nang kong nusia kei ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin a ihmutna panin Jakob khanglo a, “Hih lai munah Topa om taktak hi; keimah in tua thu ka thei kei hi,” ci hi.
Amah lau a, “Hih mun bangzahin lamdang! Hih in Pasian’ inn lo a dang hilo a, hih in vantung kongpi ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin zingsangin Jakob tho baih a, amah in lukham-a a zat suang la-in khuam-in phut a, a tungah sathau sung hi.
Amah in tua mun Beth-el ci hi; ahih hangin a masa-in tua khuamin pen Luz ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Jakob in thuciamna khat bawlin, “Pasian in kei tawh hong om khop a, hih ka paina lampi-ah kei hong kep a, nek ding an leh silh ding puan hong piak a,
lungnuam takin ka pa’ innah ka ciahkik leh, Topa in keima' Pasian hi ding a,
khuam ka phuhsa hih suang in Pasian’ inn hi ding hi; keima' tungah nangmah in nong piak khempeuh seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat nang' tungah kong pia ding hi,” ci hi.
